description: Get the full structured result from Wolfram Alpha. Returns named "pods" (Input, Result, Solution, Plot, Properties, etc.) — useful when short_answer is too terse or you need multiple facets (e.g., element properties, equation solution + plot + alternate forms).

format.description: plaintext (default) | plaintext,image — plaintext is most agent-friendly.

include_pods.description: Comma-separated pod IDs to restrict (e.g., "Result,Solution"). Default: return all.

name: full_query
